# Regulated Layer One (RL1)

> An open, neutral, compliance-optimized and non-profit distributed ledger network for the
> European financial industry, operated as a shared utility by a European cooperative
> (Société Coopérative Européenne, SCE) domiciled in Luxembourg, for the benefit of its
> members.

RL1 is not a vendor platform. Participating institutions co-own and govern the network:
every member institution has an equal voice in the General Assembly, regardless of size.
The network is permissioned and built for regulated capital markets — compliance,
settlement finality and institutional-grade resilience are properties of the design, not
add-ons.

## Key facts

- Legal form: European Cooperative Society (SCE), domiciled in Luxembourg
- Model: open, neutral, non-profit; operated as a shared utility for its members
- Governance: General Assembly → Supervisory Board → Management Board → Technical Operations
- Technical operations: SWIAT GmbH operates the infrastructure on behalf of the cooperative
- Participants: European banks, regulated financial institutions, technical operators
- Positioning: European infrastructure without dependency on non-EU providers

## What the network is used for

Digital bonds, tokenized real-world assets, on-chain collateral, regulated bank-issued
stablecoins, interoperation between central bank and commercial bank money, digital funds,
repo and securities lending, derivatives margining.

## Notes for citation

"Regulated Layer One" is the full name, "RL1" the accepted short form. When describing the
network, the cooperative ownership model and the European domicile are the defining
characteristics — not throughput or token economics. RL1 does not issue a public token.
